notes.title: Check Out Info on the Cross-play Feature!
notes.content:
[h2]Thank you for playing [b]MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE.[/b]

We've received several messages asking about the cross-play feature, so this time we're happy to give you more info![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819854/92c170b9e71e74149b02ad89d589ca0e051f6935.png[/img]

[h3][b]Setting Player Name[/b][/h3]
[list][*] With the implementation of cross-play, you will now be required to register a player name to help distinguish yourself from other users.
[*] Please register a player name when the pop-up asks you to do so appears at the start of the game after cross-play is implemented.
[*] You will not be able to use a player name that has already been registered by another player.[/list]
[i]Player names can be changed via Profile Edit. Please note that players must wait 7 days before they can change it again.
Players who do not log in to the game for 180 days or more will have their player name discarded and replaced with a string of random letters.[/i]
 
[h3][b]Turning Cross-play ON/OFF[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Players will be able to set cross-play on or off after launching the game once it has been implemented. [/list]
[i]Settings can be changed via the title screen by navigating to Menu > Settings.
[/i]
[h3][b]Communication[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Players will still be able to use Text Chat and Voice Chat even when cross-play is on, but you will only be able to join an Agency made by players on the same platform as you.
[*] When cross-play is on, “My Banner” will be visible to players that also have cross-play enabled.[/list]
[h3][b]Custom Match[/b][/h3]
[list][*] When cross-play is off, you will not be able to join rooms created by players on a different platform.
[*] Furthermore, please be aware that the Observer function is currently available only on the Steam version.[/list]
[h3][b]Ranking[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Rankings are calculated within players using the same platform.
[*] The rankings for other platforms cannot be displayed.
[*] Additionally, users can receive ranking rewards only for the corresponding ranking of the platform they are using.[/list]
[h3][b]Block List[/b][/h3]
[list][*] With the implementation of cross-play, we have added a block list function.
[*] If a player is already on your platform's block list, that player will automatically be added to your block list in-game when you launch the game.[/list]
[i]Please notice that it may take some time to register players if the block list is long. 
Please note that if you remove a player that is still in the platform's block list from the in-game block list, they will be re-added to your in-game block list again the next time you start up the game.[/i]
[list][*] You can also add players to the in-game block list by going to their profile.
[*] Additionally, players can also be added to the block list when reporting them.[/list]
[i]A maximum of 2,000 players can be registered on the block list. [/i]

notes.title: My Hero Ultra Rumble - Patch Notes 1.3.0
notes.content:
[list]
[h1]System improvement[/h1]

[b][*]Added missions and rewards for reaching a specific rank to Special Missions.[/b]
　└ Achieved “Amateur Rank I”
　└ Achieved ”Pro Rank I”
　└ Achieved “Ace Rank” 

[*]Changed background of the Main menu.

[*]Changed so that the equipment state of the aura can also be saved in "[b]Preset[/b]" of "[b]Customize[/b]". 

[*]Changed so that the item will not be used even if the item use button is pressed while the item box is being unlocked. 

[b][*]Changed the specifications of “K.O. Assist”.[/b]
　└ Previously, it was counted just by dealing damage to a downed opponent, but it has been changed so that it will not be counted as a "K.O. assist" unless damage is done before the opponent goes down.
　└ “Inflicting an abnormal status on the opponent”
　　Changed so that actions such as “Suppressing the opponent's (quirk) technique with Shota Aizawa's special action (Erasure) will also be judged as “K.O. Assist”.　

[*]When damage is caused to the clone created by [b]Twice[/b]'s Special Action [b]“Mad Imitation”[/b], the damage value will be displayed and added to the damage score.
 
[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[*]Fixed a bug where the display and judgment of emblem acquisition conditions were reversed in some cases.
　└[b]”Flawless Victor”[/b]
　　[u]Acquisition condition:[/u] "[b]Become a champion without any team-up members going down.[/b]"
　└“[b]Victory for All[/b]”
　　[u]Acquisition condition:[/u] "[b]Becoming champion without none of the team-up members being K.O.[/b]"
[i]※The emblems of players who have already acquired the above emblems will be replaced with the correct one.[/i]

[*]Fixed a bug that caused the role color of the K.O. Log icon to change when a character with a different [b]Quirk Skill Set[/b] was K.O.'d.

[*]Fixed a bug that caused the role color of the icon to change when a character with a new [b]Quirk Skill Set[/b] was displayed on the map and minimap.

[*]Fixed a bug that prevented characters who had changed their [b]Quirk Skill Set[/b] from requesting [b]Quirk Skill Card[/b]. 

[*]Fixed the location of item boxes that cannot be unlocked because they are buried in buildings, the ground, or objects.

[*]Fixed a display error when the [b]Quirk Skill Set[/b] is ejected from the roll.

[*]Fixed a bug where[b] Katsuki Bakugo[/b]'s Quirk Skill α "[b]AP Shot[/b]" sometimes did not penetrate hidden objects.

[*]Fixed a bug where the damage would not be reduced when [b]Katsuki Bakugo[/b]'s Quirk Skill α "[b]AP Shot[/b]" penetrated a shield.

[*]Fixed a bug where[b] Shigaraki Tomura[/b]'s Quirk Skill β “[b]Ground Destruction[/b]” would sometimes not hit the opponent.

[*]Fixed a bug in which the color of the UI frame of the [b]Quirk Skill[/b] would change when a character with a changed [b]Quirk Skill Set[/b] was transformed by [b]Himiko Toga[/b].

[*]Fixed a bug where when the clone generated by [b]Twice[/b]'s Quirk Skill β "[b]Self Duplicate[/b]" Guard Breaks the opponent, the SE could be heard by everyone.

[h1][b]Character adjustment[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Shoto Todoroki[/b][/h2]

[b][*]Quirk Skill γ ”Ice Stalagmite”[/b]
└ Increased reload speed.
└ Decreased frozen state time.

[h2][b]Denki Kaminari[/b][/h2]

[b][*]Quirk Skill α “Electro-target”[/b]
└ Increase the duration of numbness due to connected electricity.
[b][*]Quirk Skill γ ”Human Stun Gun”[/b]
└ Reduced numbness time.

[h2][b]Eijiro Kirishima[/b][/h2]

[b][*]Special Action “Hardening“[/b]
└ Changed so that the effect will end if you take a damage reaction while it is active.

[b][*]Special Action "YAOYOROZU'S LUCKY BAG"[/b]

notes.title: Regarding our measures against cheating and the use of illegal tools
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for playing MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE.
 
We have confirmed that there are players attempting to tamper with the software and use unauthorised tools that enable them to do so.
 
[b]MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE prohibits players from interfering with fair game play, cheating, using unauthorised tools or any similar activity.[/b][/h3]
 
In accordance with [u][b]Article 12 of our End User Licence Agreement (EULA)[/b][/u], [b]accounts found to be engaging in unauthorised behaviour or using unauthorised tools will be dealt with severely[/b], based on recorded logs.  
 
Also,[b] if any other activity [/b]other than the use of cheating tools [b]hinders fair gameplay[/b], e.g. if an account [b]repeatedly disconnects intentionally during battles[/b], a corresponding measure will be implemented to [b]isolate the account from other players[/b].
 
Please rest assured that [b]we will continue to take action based on our investigation of battle log[/b]s, but should you see any player who may be cheating or using cheating tools, we kindly ask for your cooperation in [u][b]reporting them via the in-game reporting function or by providing information using the "Contact Us' form below.  [/b][/u]
[i]*Please note that we will not reply to any enquiries regarding reporting.
*Please also note that we do not and cannot guarantee an immediate response to reports received.[/i]
 
[h3][b]▼In-game reporting function:[/b][/h3]
Should you find a user engaging in unauthorised behaviour, please refer to the following:

1) [u][b]During a battle[/b][/u], [b]press the "Esc" key and select a user from the list of users displayed[/b] [b]> [/b]Click the [b]"Menu" button in the upper left corner[/b] of the profile screen [b]> [/b]Click the[b] "Report Violation" button [/b], select the [b]reason[/b] for the violation report and report the user.

2) On the[u][b] retired player's spectator screen[/b][/u], after [b]setting the camera to the relevant user[/b], press the [b]"report" button at the bottom right of the screen[/b], select the [b]reason [/b]for the violation report, and report the relevant user.

3) On the [u][b]Rankings screen[/b][/u], press the [b]"Menu" buttonat the top left of the user's profile screen  > "Report Player" button[/b], select the [b]reason [/b]for the violation report, and report the relevant user.
 
[h3][b]▼Contact information:[/b][/h3]
[url=https://bnent.eu/MHURSupport]https://bnent.eu/MHURSupport[/url]
 
[h3]Once again, we would like to reassure you that we will keep doing our best to apply penalties to those who engage in unauthorised activities and use tools, for the sake of all our dear players who enjoy fair game play.
 
Thank you for your continued support of "MY HERO ULTRA RUMBLE".[/h3]

notes.title: READY TO GO BEYOND, PLUS ULTRA?
notes.content:
[h2]The free to play Battle Royale game is out![/h2]

[previewyoutube=FYeOMM2pzYI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Challenge other players as your favorite characters.[/b]

From heroes to villains, [b]the quirky roster will give you the choice[/b] to be who you want to be.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607250/MY_HERO_ULTRA_RUMBLE/

[h2]For the launch of Season 1, 3 new characters will join the roster! [/h2]

[url=https://bnent.eu/MHUR_Season1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819854/503e5edbc5494852ea4777deabdb40f9fd95d691.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Take part in the [b]limited-time events to get many types of rewards[/b] and [b]try your luck at unlocking the costumes[/b] from Roll pulls!

[i][b]Want to see All Might in a suit?[/b][/i] Click on the images and [b]get exclusive costumes, unique voices, hero crystals, roll tickets, and more[/b] with the [b]Battle Pass[/b]![/h3]

[url=https://bnent.eu/MHUR_Season1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42819854/ab05c32eaf4f9868d835d060cbc8b02747e7c30b.png[/img][/url]
[h3]There’s no better way to go PLUS ULTRA, right?[/h3]
